children: Raiffeisen Bank International denied allegations made in a short-seller report about its business in Russia.
In a report, short-seller Grizzly Research questioned the lender's reliance on its Russian business and trade-sanction controls.

Grizzly also alleged that Raiffeisen is a key channel for circumventing sanctions in Russia, an issue that extended to Iran ​and North Korea, and questioned the bank's assurances to investors, regulators, and the public that it was gradually scaling back its Russian operations.
The stock fell as much as 9.8% on Thursday.
Raiffeisen said it identified a number of factually wrong and misleading statements.

"We stand by the strength of our compliance systems, which have been reviewed many times--both prior to and since the start of the full scale invasion [of Ukraine]," a spokesperson for Raiffeisen said.
